text: Acceptance requires final `dogfood-status.json` to report top-level `status: ok`, empty `data.issues`, and `data.runtime.status: idle`; `dogfood-sync.json` to report `status: ok` and include `distill`, `apply`, `verify`, and `export` steps; `dogfood-verify.json` and `dogfood-replay.json` to report `status: ok` with non-empty result arrays; and `dogfood-drift.txt` to include `drift: ok` while excluding `POLICY_DENIED`.
